subject: maths
question: Aravind deposited Rs. 18,500 for 5 years at simple interest. After 5 years, he received Rs. 4,625 as interest. The annual rate of interest was:
solution:
Given

Aravind deposited in bank = Rs. 18500

Time = 5 years

He got as an interest = Rs. 4625

Formula used 

R = (S.I. × 100)/(P × T)

Where,

R → Rate of interest 

S.I. → Simple interest 

P → Principal 

T → Time 

Calculation

R = (S.I. × 100)/(P × T)

⇒ R = (4625 × 100)/(18500 × 5) 

⇒ R = 5% 

∴ The rate of interest is 5%
